scope: Independent static audit for v19 HS SDR. No v18 source or running board modified.

actual_board.rail_evidence: evidence/emmc-electrical-capability-audit-20261116.json: ALDO3 fixed 1.8V, not the ios default3.3V

frequency_bucket.donor_logic: freq_index=0 <=400k,1 <=25M,2 <=50M,3 <=100M,4 <=150M,5 <=200M. Choose byte(index%4) of freq(index/4). 0xff means donor default, not delay63.
frequency_bucket.pitfall: A literal52MHz falls into idx3 and loses actual-board sample32; do not conflate HS52 mode with exact52MHz clock.

masked_registers.name: CTRL
masked_registers.requirement: change DDR-mode field with module clock gated per donor; preserve all unrelated bits

masked_registers.name: CLKDIV
masked_registers.purpose: SDR controller divider0; module clock is2x cardclock

masked_registers.name: NTSR
masked_registers.purpose: donor clears MODE_SEL31 (1x/old sample-output mode); keep HS400 new sample disabled; preserve input-phase-clear/sample-phase fields

masked_registers.name: EDSD
masked_registers.purpose: disable HS400; preserve HALF_START_BIT0 and unrelated bits

masked_registers.name: CSDC
masked_registers.purpose: CRC detector parameter for modes other than HS400

masked_registers.name: DRV_DL
masked_registers.purpose: command180degrees/data90degrees in SDR; write while module clock gated

masked_registers.name: SAMP_DL
masked_registers.purpose: enable software delay, use live-board HS sampling point32 in50MHz bucket; preserve reserved/read-only bits

masked_registers.name: DS_DL
masked_registers.purpose: donor non-HS400 strobe delay0 with software enable; not an HS400-tuning claim

safe_transition: MMC core serializes ios changes against requests; never change clocks mid-DMA
Disable card output clock with DAT0 masked and issue update-clock command; bounded wait for CMD_START clear. If this fails, do not proceed.

Gate module clock before changing parent/dividers or CTRL DDR bit. Select validated fixed parent and exact divisor without retuning PLL or changing power. Restore module clock only after register readback succeeds.
Program SDR NTSR/EDSD/CSDC and width; module-gate around DRV_DL change (Tina sunxi_r_op pattern); program SAMP_DL and DS_DL with card clock still disabled.

Enable card output clock with DAT0 masked; issue update-clock command and bound completion; unmask DAT0 after successful update. Propagate every failure to ios_error so requests fail instead of running at uncertain timing.
Report calculated card frequency in mmc->actual_clock. Preserve v18 DMA/failure handling; do not enable CQE or high-speed DDR caps.

fixed_1v8_ios.implementation: start_signal_voltage_switch returns0 only for MMC_SIGNAL_VOLTAGE_180, returns-EINVAL for330 or120; performs no MMIO, regulator or pin-voltage writes
fixed_1v8_ios.core_proof: Linux core mmc_set_initial_signal_voltage tries330 then180 then120. mmc_set_signal_voltage sets ios before callback and restores old value on error. Initial330 rejection naturally leads to180 success and truthful ios.
fixed_1v8_ios.ocr: Keep OCR3.2-3.4V: OCR describes card VCC, not1.8V VCCQ.
fixed_1v8_ios.optional_guard: MMC_CAP2_AVOID_3_3V rejects accidental330 at end of card initialization

caps.reason: MMC core performs card HS_TIMING transition based on capability; HS SDR does not require CMD21 tuning. Do not manually switch card modes in set_ios.

required_board_evidence: EXT_CSD HS_TIMING1 read-only after card init
SAMP_DL low6bits32 at50MHz; masked register readbacks
rootfs/scratch hashes and read/write throughput before/after againstv18
no timeout/CRC/start-bit/DMA errors across cold boot and bounded repeated IO
